additional_context: FHIR-31670 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA issue whose resolution lists the exact concepts added to relatedperson-relationshiptype. FHIR-15841 is broader background for the split between personal relationship and functional role; current RelatedPerson.role uses relatedperson-relationshiptype. PA minutes and Zulip searches found related background but no conflicting final decision.

No source edit was made because source/relatedperson/valueset-relatedperson-relationshiptype.xml already contains GUARD and the power-of-attorney codes, and source/relatedperson/structuredefinition-RelatedPerson.xml binds RelatedPerson.role to that value set in an active RelatedPerson resource.
